verdict.rationale: Google Cloud runs a public status page with service status information (status.cloud.google.com) and offers Personalized Service Health with project-specific incident detail, alerts, API data and logs. Community reports describe the page lagging real outages by about an hour (its updater ran on the affected infrastructure) and showing services as 'Available' during a regional incident. That weakens the 'real' surface but does not negate it, since incidents were still eventually reported. Missing for 10: documented per-service incident history, documented post-incident reports/RCAs, and evidence of timely, accurate status updates during outages.
